scope: Archived same-initial U7E M41 tradeoffs, not a new global search. Historical R11 20-contract peak and actual CKT terminal-code 8-track loads are separate. Each new candidate uses its own robust policy: six independent 0.5..5x costs, one million scenarios per member; 1..10x stress grid also retained. Current terminal-letter loads include auxiliaries, exclude selection/page/space/errors; members equal and character:word2:word3:word4 event weights 1:3:1:1, expected keystrokes aggregated before taking shares. Pair rates are within-code.
